_about: Maple Grove residents (the cast Alex set on 2026-11-12). 'pos' and 'talk_spot' are world positions (x, y, z); 'works_in' (shop / bakery / office / homegoods) puts them behind their counter inside that building instead (data/interiors.json), wherever it stands, and 'pos' is only used if the building is missing; 'at' puts them by a building that isn't walk-in (its 'building' is a Town.built kind such as building_cafe or market_stall; 'pos' and 'talk' are [x, z] in that building's own space, its front toward +z), so they follow it when the world editor moves it; 'stall' sends them to a stall ('at' format) during its 'hours' [from, to] and back to work after; 'post_round' is the hour the postwoman sets out on her round, door to door and past Nora's farm (main.gd _update_rounds); 'roam' is how far they wander (x, z); 'loves' is an item id and 'likes' a list of them (gifts: loved > liked > anything else); 'romance': true means gifts and scenes can grow romance with them; 'start' is where their relationship stats begin (trust runs -50..100); 'route' is a round of [x, z] stops walked all day; 'look.extra' is apron / glasses / hat. 'look.model' (a character id from characters.json) gives them a full rigged body instead of the simple one.
